annotations.title: Search US tech jobs on Dice

description: US tech jobs from Dice by keyword and city: title, company, location, salary text, employer type (direct hire or recruiter), Easy Apply, remote / on-site / hybrid, posted and updated dates. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/dice-jobs-scraper on your Apify account (about $0.00055 per job; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

location.description: Optional US city or state, e.g. "Austin, TX".

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 300). Cost scales with this.

query.description: What to search for, e.g. "data engineer", "java developer".

name: search_tech_jobs

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search US tech jobs on Dice
